messages:
emma_sales: Hi team — POC with HealthCo (APAC, gov workload). We tried to pin model redwood-llama-70b-v2@2025-11-01 in ap-southeast-1 for data residency, but requests are failing (404 model_not_found) and sometimes 429 rate_limit. Customer needs an unblock today. Logs below.

raj_se: Can you paste the curl you used and the exact response body? 429 + 404 together usually means either replication or routing fallback issues.

emma_sales: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-llama-70b-v2@2025-11-01","input":"summarize: ...","region":"ap-southeast-1"}'
```
Response samples:
```json
{"error":"model_not_found","message":"Model redwood-llama-70b-v2 not available in region ap-southeast-1"}
```
and occasionally:
```json
{"error":"rate_limit","retry_after":12}
```

olivia_sec: Quick question — is this the hosted tenant or Private (VPC/on-prem)? Any custom KMS in use?

emma_sales: Hosted trial tenant. No custom KMS. The customer cares about APAC residency so we attempted region pin.

tim_infra: FYI — 70b-v2 hasn't been replicated to ap-southeast-1 due to licensing + capacity constraints. We avoid spinning up short-lived replicas for small POCs. Short-term options: 1) route to nearest region that has the model (ap-east-1) via region-fallback, 2) use a compatible variant already present in ap-southeast-1 (redwood-llama-13b-quant), 3) offer a short Dedicated trial (reserved capacity) so we can provision local replica.

raj_se: For immediate unblock, try either: set model to `redwood-llama-13b-quant@v1` (in-region) or add the header `x-redwood-region-fallback: ap-east-1` and document the latency/quality tradeoffs for the customer.

maria_cs: I'll draft messaging for the customer outlining three paths (fallback region, smaller in-region model, Dedicated trial). Can engineering give a 1-paragraph delta blurb comparing 70b-v2 -> 13b-quant?

olivia_sec: Security note: if they accept cross-region fallback we must annotate the security questionnaire — data will traverse ap-east-1. Confirm TLS in transit and retention/audit logs. If they require strict residency, only Dedicated/private deployment will meet the bar.

raj_se: Quick routing config example to present to the customer: 
```json
{"routing_policy": {"region_fallback": ["ap-southeast-1", "ap-east-1"], "fallback_models": {"redwood-llama-70b-v2": "redwood-llama-13b-quant"}}}
```
Explain to customer: region_fallback preserves request origin but will transparently route to ap-east-1 when model missing; fallback_models swaps to a quantized variant in the same region when lower latency is required.

emma_sales: Great. I'll send that as option A/B/C. Also need a rough price for a 2-week Dedicated trial (approx 8 A100-equivalents).

tim_infra: Ballpark: $6k-$10k per week depending on burst capacity and SRE on-call. If they want guaranteed local model with SLA, that's the path. I'll loop in finance for exact quote.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: added 2 nodes to pool-redwood-ap-east-1 at 1789200500 :rocket:

maria_cs: Thanks all — I'll consolidate and send to HealthCo before EOD. Will include the routing snippet and the security caveats. :thumbsup:
